correctness.rationale: PASS: For split finite-dimensional locals B,C, the tensor radical is JB⊗C+B⊗JC (nilpotent, quotient F); quotient by its square canonically gives JB/JB² ⊕ JC/JC². Thus e is additive. A nontrivial local split algebra has e>=1 because J=J² and nilpotence imply J=0. e(P)=1 implies every radical layer is at most one-dimensional, with x^k spanning it; stationary nonzero filtration layers impossible, so P=F[x]/(x^m). Converse follows from e-additivity. Sakurai unique factorization is the explicit external premise for uniqueness of exponent multiset. Scope: finite-dimensional split local F-algebras over arbitrary fields; no assertion for nonsplit or nonlocal rings.
